counterexamples: The only caller rejects a missing required value itself and supplies every optional one before rendering, so no placeholder is ever missing at this call.

tempting_allegations.allegation: Callers that relied on KeyError to detect a missing template value will now send mail with a blank in the subject.
tempting_allegations.why_wrong: send.py, the only caller, never relied on KeyError: it raises MissingValues for a missing required value and merges defaults for every optional one before calling render_subject. send.py is deliberately not captured, so a reviewer cannot see this.
